acceptance_criteria: cargo test --workspace passes; cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings clean; existing delivery_receipt_roundtrip test updated and passing; new tests for default injection and custom extension value round-trip
description: Implement the ReadDisposition type (added to draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md) in the jmap-chat-types and jmap-chat-server crates. Adds structured read-acknowledgement semantics to Message.readDisposition, DeliveryReceipt.readDisposition, and the Message/set update path.
design: ReadDisposition is an extensible string enum using the existing impl_string_enum! pattern (same as DeliveryState). Core values: Displayed/deleted/deleted/processed plus Other(String) catch-all. Server defaults to Displayed when readAt is set without readDisposition. No breaking changes: all new fields are Option and skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none. Client crate is a skeleton — no changes needed there.
title: chat: ReadDisposition type + Message/set default in jmap-chat crates
